limitations: This is precommit evidence over one dirty child worktree. A later CP-0029 umbrella must bind the clean runtime commit, updated setup locks, schema-8 prefix, and final root checkpoint.
The focused queue rebuild reused the CP-0028 local GCC build configuration; the separate GCC and Clang matrices each used a fresh temporary configure and build tree.
The two skipped tests are existing opt-in live endpoint/OpenCL execution gates. They do not substitute for the independent schema-8 OpenCL and Triton product runs required later in CP-0029.
expect_peer_close uses a one-second wall-clock timeout; 1,900 retained stress runs did not expose a scheduling failure, but this is not a timing guarantee.
No repository-local prefix, broader Triton operator, model inference, stable multi-token decode, tensor parallelism, CCL, profiling, or performance result is accepted here.
result: Only tests/queue_test.c changed; 100 serial and 1,800 concurrent queue runs pass without failure or timeout, and fresh GCC and Clang builds each pass all 22 runtime CTests with two expected opt-in skips.
